Lucy has always been a bit of a wild child, liking to experiment, have fun and be her own self. Michael met her when at college and they enjoyed a brief love affair before she simply disappeared.

Lucy is a wild one, always looking for the next fun thing to do or try and so it is no surprise that she would be found working at a place like the Maid Café. Lucy and the protagonist has a brief whirlwind romance when they were in college before she simply left him to pursue some other new interest.

Whilst Lucy seems to have settled down with this job, it is hard to see if her wild ways and carefree nature have gone or if her interest in the protagonists return is simply her wanting to have more fun with Michael and with the other girls of the café.
